leads.title: Bank OZK takes 808 Windsor St. Somerville, MA lab building via deed-in-lieu-of-foreclosure after failed sale, writes down $37M
leads.why: Bisnow (citing deed records) reports Bank OZK took title to the 346,000 SF lab/retail building at 808 Windsor St. in Somerville's Boynton Yards campus via a deed-in-lieu-of-foreclosure dated September 29, 2026, after a planned sale fell through. Bank OZK's October 2026 earnings release disclosed taking control of the property and a $37M write-down of its value (carried at $132M, which Bisnow says is 80% of assessed value); the bank has engaged a property manager and says it is in discussions with an interested purchaser. The original borrower was a partnership of Leggat McCall Properties, DLJ Real Estate Capital Partners and Deutsche Finance America, which took a $246M five-year construction loan from Bank OZK (arranged by JLL Capital Markets) in Dec. 2021; the building was completed in 2024 but struggled to lease up amid the life-sciences/lab-space demand slowdown. Connect CRE's Nov. 19, 2026 'Return to Lender' column (citing the Boston Business Journal) carries the same takeback this week but gives a conflicting $165M as-is value figure — the newsroom should resolve the valuation discrepancy against the primary BBJ/deed-record reporting before publishing. Not yet in js/data.js (checked by address, developer and lender names). Likely category lending-foreclosure, propertyType Life Sciences, state MA.
